text:
releasebot: Created tag `v2.8.0-rc.1` on branch `main` (commit `a1b2c3d4`). Condensed changelog:
- kv-cache eviction tuning
- p95 tail latency improvements for 8k context
- canary routing by region (prod-us first)
- fix metrics emitter race condition
Targets: prod-us, prod-eu. Canary: 10% prod-us.

elaine: ack — starting prod-us canary at 09:15 PT. @miguel will you pin runtime images for the canary?

miguel: pinning runtime -> `runtime-1.12` for gpu-pool images on prod-us now. pushing image tags, ETA ~3m.

ops-bot: prod-us canary deployment STARTED for `v2.8.0-rc.1` on pool `gpu-a` (job id 8853). Rolling 10% of traffic.

sam: quick Q — how long do we observe before increasing canary?

elaine: plan: 30m baseline, check health + errors, then 50% for 15m, then full. If any customer-facing errors -> rollback.

kai: adding route-pin for `/api/v1/generate` on prod-eu so critical traffic stays on `v2.7.x` until we clear canary.

ops-bot: canary health checks: 200/200 over last 5m. p95 latency down 8% vs baseline. No 5xx spikes.

jen: noticing intermittent `kv cache miss` warnings in canary logs (~3/min). Investigating root cause; not yet surfaced to users.

miguel: looked at logs — noisy warnings from eviction threshold, not functional errors. Increasing metric verbosity to track.

elaine: continue monitoring. If no regressions in 45m we tag final `v2.8.0` and start rollout. Rollback procedure: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/redwood-runtime -n prod` and follow rollback checklist in runbook.

releasebot: Updated tag to `v2.8.0` and published short release notes: https://internal/release/v2.8.0 (summary + rollback steps). Release notes include SDK compatibility note and model runtime pinning recommendations.

sam: I'll add the SDK compatibility line to the notes and pin the client lib to `1.3.2` in the docs.

ops-bot: full rollout to prod-us INITIATED at 10:05 PT (job id 8858).

releasebot: prod-us rollout COMPLETE at 10:22 PT. Starting prod-eu canary (10%).

elaine: nice. We'll keep a 1h observation window post-rollout before closing the change window. Triage channel = #incidents if anything odd shows. :thumbsup:

jen: will report back if the `kv cache miss` becomes actionable; for now it looks informational.

ops-bot: prod-eu canary health OK for first 10m. No user-facing errors so far.

elaine: thanks everyone — leaving this thread open until end of window. If anything critical happens, escalate.
